name: Grotto Valle Pino
kurzbeschreibung: Italian restaurant in the ...liebes Rot-Flüh wellness hotel on the Haldensee lake in Grän, with wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta and a pool terrace.
beschreibung: Grotto Valle Pino is the Italian restaurant in the ...liebes Rot-Flüh wellness hotel on the Haldensee lake in Grän, in the Tannheimer Tal in the Außerfern. Here Mediterranean aromas meet the Tyrolean mountain world: the menu features wood-fired pizza and homemade pasta, prepared with ingredients that are as regional and high-quality as possible. On mild summer evenings the pool terrace invites you to linger, and there is also a special grill table for sociable barbecue evenings. The restaurant is open from Friday to Wednesday from 13:00 to 21:00; Thursday is a rest day. Hotel guests enjoy a light midday snack with soups and a salad buffet every day as part of the pampering board. A piece of Italian hospitality in a quiet mountain setting.
